phaseIncluded.name: Preparation
phaseIncluded.description: Configure registration campaign, identify pilot group, prepare communications, set up break-glass accounts.

tasks.graphAction: Create 2 cloud-only accounts with Global Administrator role, exclude from all CA/registration policies

tasks.task: Enable Authentication Methods Registration Campaign in report-only mode

tasks.graphAction: Create Entra ID security group 'MFA-Pilot-Group', add members per pilot group concept
Send 'Announcement' email template to all users (T-5 days)
Distribute helpdesk FAQ to support staff, walk through top 5 expected ticket types

phasesNotIncluded: Phase 1 — Pilot Rollout (5 days) — pilot enforcement, go/no-go criteria, feedback collection
Phase 2 — Phased Full Rollout (8 days) — Wave A / Wave B sequencing, exception handling in flight
Phase 3 — Enforcement & Stabilization (3 days) — CA003 enforcement, post-rollout monitoring

pilotGroupConceptIncluded.sizeRecommendation: 5-10% of total user count, minimum 5 users, maximum 25 for tenants up to 300 users
selectionCriteria: Include at least 2 IT/helpdesk staff (early feedback, technical fluency)
Include 1-2 executives or department heads (visible champions, smooths broader rollout)
Include a mix of device types (Windows, Mac, mobile-only users)
Include at least 1 user known to be less tech-comfortable (surfaces UX issues for everyone else)
Avoid including anyone on critical deadline work during the pilot week (e.g. finance during month-end close)
